item.title: floorp-bin: drop
item.description:
Our floorp-bin package has currently two problems (as far as i see it):

  1. We have a rule that all browsers must have at least one committer among the maintainers, who actively reviews, merges and backports updates. This ensures no critical fixes are delayed unnecessarily, endangering unsuspecting users. This requirement is not met here.
  2. Updates have only been happening intermittently. That is fine for non critical packages, but browsers, with their constant security issues, unfortunately require need more attention. Some examples can be seen here:
    • #539905 (update PR, open for 30 days)
    • #556346 (17 days until a backport happened)
    • #564266 (bot pr, two weeks until someone took care of it)
    • #575715 (good that it happened, but bad that it occurred in the first place)
    • #592735 (still open, update was 11 days old when the bot opened it)

Dropping this package doesn't mean nobody can use the package. It just means we currently don't seem to have the capacity to take care of it in an appropriate way and don't want to endanger unsuspecting users. NixOS offers many great ways not to be reliant on a central package database and building a bin package locally isn't resource intensive.

I'm review-requesting @misuzu here because they have merged many of the floorp updates in the past.
